title: Grouped Progressively-Disclosed Context Menus
description:
Follow-up to the universal on-demand context-menu effort (prior ticket UNIVERSAL-CONTEXT-SPECIFIC-RIGHT-CLICK-MENUS, now superseded/consolidated by concurrent sessions — that architecture is done: all 14 plugin apps implement DocumentApp::context_menu over the binary exchange/AppCommand channel, legacy contextMenuJson is deleted, most surfaces are wired).

Problem now: every menu is flat. The shell fallback shows 30-45 rows, neither renderer clamps/scrolls long menus (they run off-screen), and none of the 14 plugin emitters use the existing (zero-call-site) Menu::submenu builder. User requirement: menus must not be visually cluttered — top level shows a few primary context-specific items plus group entries; groups open progressively as a tree (progressive disclosure), executed end-to-end via a multi-agent Workflow.

Full mechanism design (D1-D7) and 8-phase workflow orchestration plan are in /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/everything-must-have-a-atomic-kazoo.md — read that first. Summary: no wire-schema change (children=group, labeled-separator=header); a shared pure `organize_context_menu` function (Rust in ui-wgpu crate + TS twin in framework core) enforced at the SDK's VcsDocumentApp::context_menu funnel auto-groups any emitter's output to ≤9 rows/level, ≤5 primaries, destructive-last; ActionDefinition gains a `.with_category()` builder feeding a unified 20-id UiRibbonParentCategory taxonomy; both renderers (React ui-react ContextMenuController + wgpu render_context_menu_level) get group-header rendering, max-height/scroll, viewport clamp/flip, and click-to-open parent rows; shell fallback menus (both renderers) rebuilt on shared spec builders; a handful of real bugs fold in (unbound requestContextMenu in WasmEditorSurface breaking the text-editor menu today, wgpu request missing selection/text, SDK view_state required-but-discarded + double JSON hop, dead code, stale tests); all 14 plugin emitters migrated to grouped form (5 of them normalized off raw-vec construction onto the Menu builder first); 9 still-unwired scene surfaces (canvas2d, table, paint2d, ink-canvas, graph-timeline, block-list, diff-view, event-feed, virtualFileSystem) get requestContextMenu wiring with fallback-to-shell-on-empty.

Executed via Workflow tool per the plan's phase structure (pre-flight baseline, core mechanism pipeline with a hard gate, plugin fan-out in parallel with a strictly-serialized renderer-engine lane, verification matrix, adversarial review, main-session live browser smoke, completeness critic).
